steps.what: Establish the materials and replacement parts needed for the actual maintenance job
Find compatible materials, tools or replacement parts and their stock status
Enter the materials, quantities and job references in the requisition
Check the final materials requisition and actual purchasing destination
Submit the checked materials requisition to the purchasing team
Save the materials requisition in its existing screen

tasks.design: Link the asset parts list and stock catalogue in {OPS_SYSTEM} to native {PROCUREMENT} forms. The supervisor checks compatibility and the complete request before a separate purchasing submission; the system does not approve or place a supplier order.
tasks.previous_blocker: Part references and asset details are searched and copied between maintenance and purchasing screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Native asset-catalogue links and reusable request fields handle this repetition.
tasks.still_hard: A similar-looking part may be incompatible with the actual asset revision.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the repair and reject an unsuitable substitute.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: asset-linked parts catalogues and requisition forms can reduce reference copying while compatibility and purchase decisions remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is actual need verification, part lookup and requisition submission, not buying the part. The existing purchasing team receives and decides the request.

Maintenance engineering supplies asset model, revision and approved part references; stores supplies current stock and units; the supervisor supplies actual quantity and job need. Missing mappings are read and entered manually within retained work and incremental repair.

s2 removes7.5 units of repeated catalogue navigation, retaining22.5 for compatibility and stock reading. s3 removes six units of stable job and part-reference entry, retaining twenty-four for quantities, urgency and checks. Native functions already used earn no new saving.

s4 checks the exact request and destination for actual delivery to purchasing, not self-approval of the request or approval to save. Changed fields or routing void it. Same-system save is tiny, fully retained and ungated. Shares are illustrative.
unknowns: Whether asset part links already exist
Whether the actual request route has separate manual submission work
research_questions: Can catalogue reuse preserve asset revision and unit of measure?

already_counted.description: Establish need, read compatibility, complete and check request and save

incremental.description: Repair missing asset-part mappings and failed purchasing submissions

approvals.approved_version: Exact part codes, quantities, asset references and purchasing destination checked in s4

tasks.short: Confer about work and resource needs

steps.what: Read the work activities and resource context relevant to the personnel discussion
Confer with relevant personnel to coordinate work activities and review resource needs
Update the actual working plan with agreed work and resource implications

tasks.design: Configure a linked current-work view in {OPS_SYSTEM} and reuse stable work-order references in the actual working plan. The supervisor confers directly and writes the real coordination implications without a new meeting report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing work context requires screen switching and stable references are copied again.
tasks.enabler_now: Native work-order links remove limited navigation and reference entry.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting operational priorities and resource constraints need negotiation among people.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the participants' constraints and reach a practical agreement.

ambition.what: Coordination and personnel authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked work views can reduce context navigation while coordination conversations remain human.

assumptions: Representative episode is operational coordination and resource discussion with an actual working maintenance plan used by the supervisor. A confidential grievance follows its existing case route rather than being written into this operational plan.

Planning and stores produce existing work-order id, status and resource references; participants supply actual coordination outcomes in s2. The supervisor captures them in s3. No free meeting transcript or new resource data feed is assumed.
s1 removes1.5 units of screen switching. s3 removes0.75 units of stable references, retaining14.25 for actual changes and checking. Ordinary same-system save is negligible and ungated.
No new minutes, operative dispatch or purchase commitment is invented; native runtime already present earns no labour gain.
unknowns: Whether the actual discussion changes a working plan
How much context is already shown together
research_questions: Does linking the work order remove navigation without obscuring unresolved resource constraints?

incremental.description: Maintain current-work links and form references

tasks.short: Determine safe maintenance assignments and schedules

steps.what: Read work priorities, equipment requirements and current personnel qualifications
Compare proposed schedules with fixed equipment, shift and qualification constraints
Determine work schedules, sequences and assignments using operational judgement
Enter the selected schedules and assignments in the actual planning board
Check the final schedules and assignments against current readiness before issue
Send the checked work schedules and assignments to the maintenance team
Save the work schedule in the same planning board

tasks.design: Use native planning views and deterministic constraint checks in {OPS_SYSTEM}, keeping the supervisor's allocation decision separate. After the complete schedule is checked against current readiness, {CHAT} delivers its exact instruction snapshot; the small ordinary save stays unchanged.
tasks.previous_blocker: Availability and qualifications are manually compared and the chosen allocation is copied into team messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit shift, equipment and qualification constraints can be checked without a model.
tasks.still_hard: A formally qualified person may need support on an unfamiliar or difficult job.
tasks.human_edge: Balance priority, fatigue, practical competence and safe sequencing.

ambition.what: Compare a revised sequence when an urgent repair displaces planned work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed schedule constraints can be checked deterministically while practical maintenance allocation and final instruction readiness remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is actual maintenance planning board work and delivery of team instructions, not permit issue, isolation or machine release. Those actions retain their existing authorities.

Planning supplies job id, priority, estimated duration and equipment need; qualification owners supply current qualification and shift availability. The supervisor reads and corrects missing values in s1. Incompatible calendars and manual rule repair are funded below.

s1 removes four units of view switching. s4 removes1.5 units of repeated work-order references, retaining13.5 for actual assignment entry and checking. s2 replaces actual manual fixed-constraint comparisons; existing automated checks earn no new saving.

s5 checks the full schedule and current readiness after all entries exist. Any change to workers, jobs, times or recipients voids authorization. s7 is a tiny ungated save with no labour benefit. No behaviour scoring or model allocation is introduced.
unknowns: Whether fixed comparisons are still manual
Who maintains current qualifications and availability
research_questions: Do missing qualification or equipment fields stop the check rather than imply availability?

tasks.short: Counsel employees about work and skills

steps.what: Read the employee's relevant work issue and agreed skill-development context
Counsel employees and assist them to correct actual job-skill deficiencies
Write actual agreed employee development actions in the existing restricted entry

tasks.design: Link the actual development agreement in {HCM} to current course references in {LMS}. The supervisor listens, coaches through real practice and writes the agreed actions, with only stable reference fields reused.
tasks.previous_blocker: A small amount of repeated navigation and course-reference entry surrounds the counseling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and restricted forms can remove those clerical repetitions.
tasks.still_hard: Trust and willingness to change cannot be produced by a completed form.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the employee's difficulty and give specific, respectful practical help.

ambition.what: Coaching and personnel authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing development forms can reuse stable references, while counseling and practical skill correction remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes an actual documented development agreement used at the next skills follow-up, not a new record for every informal conversation. No disciplinary decision or automatic performance score is introduced.

The employee supplies concerns; the supervisor observes actual practice and agrees actions in s2, then captures them in s3. Existing HCM and LMS owners maintain employee and course references. No free transcript, behaviour feed or new assessment dataset is assumed.

s1 removes0.5 units of navigation. s3 removes1.5 units of stable course and employee references, retaining13.5 for actual action writing and checking. Same-system save is negligible, fully retained and ungated; no self-approval is added.
unknowns: Whether this counseling has an actual development entry
Whether course references are already linked
research_questions: Does native linking save clerical work without encouraging generic development actions?

incremental.description: Maintain restricted agreement and course references
